name: preshuffle_scale_k_tail_padding
description: MX-FP8 scale preshuffle kernels operating on 16x4 blocks silently skip trailing columns when scale_cols is not a multiple of 4. Fix by zero-padding scale_cols to a multiple of 4 during preshuffle and reading with the padded stride in the consumer GEMM kernel.
preconditions: MX-FP8 GEMM with K % 128 != 0 (causing scale_cols = K/32 to miss ÷4 alignment)
Preshuffle kernel structured as `for i < cols / 4` (rounds DOWN — skips tail)
Data BufferSRD or masked load already zeroes out-of-bounds data for the tail K-iter
steps: Write a _padded variant of preshuffle that: (a) iterates cols_padded/4 times; (b) for each (row, col), reads real data if col < cols_real AND row < rows_real, else writes OutT(0)
Pass scale_cols_padded as the stride to BOTH preshuffle output allocation AND the consumer GEMM kernel — they must agree on the padded layout
Workspace size grows from m*scale_cols*4 bytes to m*scale_cols_padded*4 bytes — add to per-call workspace computation
expected_impact: Correctness fix — enables K % 128 != 0 support. On gpt_oss_20B K=2880 (scale_cols=90, not ÷4): SNR goes from 12.93 dB (garbage) to 28.46 dB (fp8 floor). Runtime cost: ~0% — 2 extra preshuffled cols per row vs 88 real.
failure_contexts: Initial HIP grouped_gemm_mxfp8 shipped with stock preshuffle_scale_16x4_kernel; K=2880 gave 12.93 dB SNR because scale cols 88..89 were uninitialised (last full 4-col block is cols 84..87). Fixed by preshuffle_scale_16x4_padded_kernel with cols_padded=92.
decision_rules: Whenever the MX-FP8 K dim is not a multiple of (128 × 4) = 512, consider the scale preshuffle padding.
e8m0 0x00 ≈ 2^-127 acts as a natural zero — zero-padding the scale buffer is sufficient to null out tail-K contributions (no separate mask needed on the data side if BufferSRD already zeroes OOB).
